items.a: FolderCast is a Roku app for browsing photos, videos, and music shared from your phone, tablet, or computer over the same local Wi-Fi network.

items.q: How do I connect my phone or computer?
items.a: Open FolderCast on Roku. Scan the QR code shown on your TV or enter the displayed address in your browser, then select the files or folders you want to share.

items.q: Do I need to install another app?
items.a: No. Use a compatible browser on your phone, tablet, or computer. No separate companion app or FolderCast account is needed.

items.q: Can I share multiple folders or devices?
items.a: Yes. Add several folders or individual media files, and connect more than one phone or computer. FolderCast keeps shared media organized by device and folder.

items.q: Do both devices need the same Wi-Fi?
items.a: Yes. Your Roku and the device sharing media must be on the same local Wi-Fi network. Internet access may still be needed for Roku installation, purchases, and account services.
Yes. The free version lets you open the first 5 subfolders and first 20 playable media files in each folder, in displayed filename order. A Roku-billed subscription unlocks full eligible browsing.
